risk_summary: The excerpt presents strong, quantified operating performance and favorable growth trends, with clear disclosure of sales, margins, leverage, interest costs, and macroeconomic sensitivities. Principal risks include wage inflation, fuel-price uncertainty, supply-chain costs, impairment and pension termination charges, and reliance on aging-vehicle demand. Overall tone is confident but appropriately acknowledges uncertainty and uses some standard non-GAAP and forward-looking language.
